{{Short description|Finnish geodesist (1933–2022)}}

'''Juhani Antero Kakkuri<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Vallner |first1=R. |last2=Rüdja |first2=Andres |last3=Ellmann |first3=Artu |date=2022 |title=In memoriam Juhani Antero Kakkuri |url=https://www.etis.ee/Portal/Publications/Display/e91355ff-a7ef-41a8-bf42-feb6545c71c6 |journal=Geodeet |pages=80–81 |issn=1406-9431 |eissn=2733-3582}}</ref>''' (September 12, 1933 – August 6, 2022) was a Finnish [[geodesist]], writer, and former director of the [[Finnish Geodetic Institute]].

Kakkuri was born in [[Kurikka]], [[Finland]] on September 12, 1933.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Poutanen |first=Markku |title=Juhani Kakkuri 1933 – 2022 |url=https://dgk.badw.de/fileadmin/user_upload/Files/DGK/Nachrufe/Obituary_Kakkuri.pdf |website=Geodäsie (DGK) |publisher=[[Bayerische Akademie der Wissenschaften]]}}</ref> He lived his childhood there, but moved to [[Helsinki]] for [[upper secondary school]], continuing his education at the [[University of Helsinki]], where he studied [[geophysics]] and physics. He received a [[Master of Science]] degree in 1960.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Poutanen |first1=Markku |last2=Kuusniemi |first2=Heidi |date=August–September 2022 |editor-last=Tóth |editor-first=Gyula |title=Obituary: Juhani Kakkuri (1933 - 2022) |url=https://www.iag-aig.org/iag-newsletters/August_September_2022 |journal=IAG Newsletter |publisher=[[International Association of Geodesy]] |pages=8–9 |doi=10.1007/s00190-022-01655-4}}{{Cbignore}}</ref>

In 2021, the autobiographical memoir ''Muistelmia geodeettien maailmasta – Memoirs From the World of Geodesy'' was published bilingually in Finnish and English.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Poutanen |first=Markku |date=April 2021 |editor-last=Tóth |editor-first=Gyula |title=Juhani Kakkuri: ''Memoirs from the World of Geodesy'' |url=https://www.iag-aig.org/iag-newsletters/April2021 |journal=IAG Newsletter |publisher=[[International Association of Geodesy]] |page=4 |doi=10.1007/s00190-021-01537-1|url-access=subscription }}{{Cbignore}}</ref> In recognition of his career, he was awarded an [[honorary doctorate]] from the [[University of Stuttgart]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sneeuw |first=Nico |date=Aug 6, 2022 |title=News: Prof. Juhani Kakkuri passed away |url=https://www.gis.uni-stuttgart.de/en/institute/news/news/Prof.-Juhani-Kakkuri-passed-away/ |access-date=2024-03-17 |website=Institute of Geodesy |publisher=[[University of Stuttgart]] |language=en}}</ref> The minor planet [[3597 Kakkuri]] is also named in his honor.<ref>{{Cite book |title=Dictionary of Minor Planet Names |date=2003 |publisher=[[Springer (publisher)|Springer]] |isbn=978-3-540-00238-3 |editor-last=Schmadel |editor-first=Lutz D. |edition=5th |pages=302–303 |chapter=(3597) Kakkuri |doi=10.1007/978-3-540-29925-7_3596}}</ref>
